`part_manifest_cleanup` (`FoldSealProto.part_manifest_cleanup`, `Layout::partManifestCleanupKey`, `Gc::writePartManifestCleanupBundle`) is a written-but-never-read artifact left over from an unfinished sharded-GC design that was superseded by the one-pass ack-floor GC (commit `774404eb3dc`, 2026-07-02): the bundle is written on every fold but no runtime reader was found that applies it, and actual manifest-body deletion instead happens post-CAS directly from in-memory `folded.mf_cleanup`; if the process crashes in that post-CAS window, recovery goes through the orphan-manifest sweep, not the persisted cleanup bundle.
